import ctypes
import os

# Define the path to the dynamic libraries
libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class gsl_sf_result(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", ctypes.c_double),
        ("err", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the function prototype for gsl_sf_bessel_I1_e
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_I1_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_result)]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_I1_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Python function to compute the Bessel function I1
def compute_bessel_I1(x):
    result = gsl_sf_result()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_I1_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("GSL function call failed with status code: {}".format(status))
    return (result.val, result.err)

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Test with a known value
    val, err = compute_bessel_I1(1.0)
    assert abs(val - 0.565159103992485) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert err < 1e-9, "Test case 1 error margin failed"

    # Test with zero
    val, err = compute_bessel_I1(0.0)
    assert val == 0.0, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert err == 0.0, "Test case 2 error margin failed"

    # Test with a negative value
    val, err = compute_bessel_I1(-1.0)
    assert abs(val + 0.565159103992485) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert err < 1e-9, "Test case 3 error margin failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
